fan2 (PRIMARY).backdrop: uniform stored 0.9647 (246/255) grey; soft composited elliptical ground shadow under the fan

meta.units: L = radius from the pivot (rivet axis) to the leaf's outer edge = pivot-to-guard-tip (flush). fan2 L = 343 px at the rivet's depth; fan1 L = 396 px. Image angle phi (deg) is measured about the rivet image, y up, 0 = image right, counter-clockwise.
meta.designed_scale: L = 190 mm, so the full stick incl. butt = 1.106 L = 210 mm (the common 21 cm silk fan) and the open width 2 L sin(81.6 deg) = 376 mm. DESIGNED.
meta.status_labels: MEASURED (read off the pixels), INFERRED (geometric or physical consequence of measured rows), DESIGNED (proposal for what neither photo shows)
meta.instrument: Blender 5.2 headless Python + NumPy 2; scripts fm_m00..fm_m26 in this folder, stage outputs fm_s*.json, helpers fm_lib.py
meta.design_masked: Painted design (fan2: willow strokes, water swirls, red seal; fan1: sakura, cats, seal) and rib piercing are NOT part of this job. Every statistic excludes design pixels (bright or saturated, dilated 2 px). fan2 design covers 12.0 % of the leaf; fan1 29.4 %.
meta.debug_dir: WorkFiles/fan/reference_metrology/debug (DEBUG, NEVER SHIP); labelled layouts DEBUG_NEVER_SHIP_fan2_layout_LABELLED.png and DEBUG_NEVER_SHIP_fan1_layout_LABELLED.png
meta.build_input_policy: The build must never read, sample, project or trace the reference pixels or the debug images; this spec is numbers and words.

projection.tolerance: a plane parallel to the sensor fails: circle about the rivet rms 4.52 px vs 1.00 px
projection.how: the outer leaf edge r(phi) about the rivet falls from 342 px at the ends to 325 px at the top (5 %) while the rib pitch stays uniform (thirds [6.718, 6.658, 6.782] deg): a plane tilted about its horizontal axis through the rivet, top away (fm_m04, fm_m10, fm_m23)

distance_to_rivet_L.how: ladder fit fm_m23: rms 0.96 (1.8 L), 1.00 (3.0 L), 1.10 (5 L), 1.34 (20 L) px, of which 0.82 px is the pleat scallop; 3.0 L chosen (46 mm lens)

tilt_alpha_deg.how: fan plane rotated about the horizontal axis through the rivet, TOP AWAY from the camera; tied to the distance (9.2 at 1.8 L, 13.2 at 5 L)

focal.how: fitted image scale s = 344.0 px per L at the rivet depth

principal_point_px.how: image centre, lens shift 0; sensor upright (optical axis level)

rivet_image_px.how: centre of the metal ring (debug/g2_rivet_x12.png); highlight centroid (397.93, 546.07)

camera_position_rel_rivet_L.how: X right, Y toward the fan (camera on -Y), Z up; camera looks along +Y and is level; the rivet sits 0.4246 L below and 0.0060 L left of the optical axis

roll_deg.how: fan bisector at image angle 91.0 deg (guard axes 9.4 and 172.6): the fan is turned 1.0 deg counter-clockwise as seen

view.how: a circle about the rivet fits the outer edge with rms 2.13 px (1.31 px of it scallop); a free-centre circle lands only 2.2 px away

fan2_guard_axis_to_guard_axis_deg.how: front guard axis 9.4 (outer edge line 8.88 deg + half width), rear guard axis 172.6 (silhouette 173.95 at 0.93 L less half width); tilt correction < 0.4 deg

opening.note: fan1 is opened ~20 deg less than fan2; the reference open pose follows fan2 (163 deg).

fan2_total.how: 25 equal gaps between the guard axes, four ways: 25 bare-zone rib boundaries (incl. the front guard's inner edge) at 11.49 + 6.658 n, whose n = 25 prediction (177.9) meets the rear guard's outer silhouette (177.3 at r = 140 px); 25 lit pleat faces; 24 edge-scallop peaks + 1 at the range end; pitch x count = opening

fan2_breakdown.how: front guard = image right, lies over the leaf; rear guard = image left, behind the leaf, visible only in the bare zone

fan2_pitch_deg.how: 163.2 / 25; single methods: rib boundaries 6.658, leaf lit faces 6.390, scallop 6.511, bare-zone fft 6.677

fan1_total.how: 29 gaps at 4.93 deg (boundaries 21.15 + 4.855 n; scallop 4.845; leaf 4.94) over 142.9 deg; overlay DEBUG_NEVER_SHIP_fan1_layout_LABELLED.png

stacking_order.value: front guard (image right) on top; each stick to its left lies behind the previous one; the leaf lies over all inner ribs and under the front guard; the rear guard is behind everything
stacking_order.tolerance: qualitative: must read the same in a side-by-side render
stacking_order.how: visible edges of the bare ribs; the front guard overlaps the leaf; the rear guard is hidden in the leaf zone

bare_length_from_pivot_L.how: leaf inner edge at 148 +- 4 px (debug/dbg_polar2_rgrid_*.png); fan1 0.462 L (183 px, radial gradient fm_m15)

butt_below_pivot_L.how: lobe of stacked rounded butts: radius 35-37.5 px about the rivet over phi 190..345 (fm_m13); fan1 0.08-0.09 L

total_length_L.how: pivot to leaf edge + butt (inner ribs run on behind the leaf; their tips are hidden)

width_at_leaf_inner_edge_L.how: pitch arc at 148 px = 16.9 px, less the 2-3 px dark boundary line; the ribs almost touch there (fan1 0.035 L)

width_near_pivot_L.how: ribs overlap near the rivet, so this is not measurable; straight edges, linear taper 0.041 -> 0.030

shoulder.value: rounded shoulders at 0.415-0.431 L, just under the leaf edge
shoulder.how: rounded rib tops at r ~146 px (debug/g2_ribs_top_x6.png) and an un-pierced band at r 142-150 px

leaf_section.value: hidden: continues behind the leaf as a narrow slip to 0.96 L, width 0.012 L, thickness 0.002 L, rounded tip
leaf_section.tolerance: DESIGNED: free within +-25 % unless it breaks a MEASURED row
leaf_section.how: the back is not visible in either photo

thickness_bare_L.tolerance: DESIGNED: free within +-25 % unless it breaks a MEASURED row
thickness_bare_L.how: 0.85 mm at L = 190; closed stack at the pivot 24 x 0.0045 + 2 x 0.010 = 0.128 L (24 mm)

butt_shape.value: rounded (semicircular) end, butt width 0.030 L; the stacked butts form the D-shaped lobe of radius 0.106 L
butt_shape.tolerance: qualitative: must read the same in a side-by-side render
butt_shape.how: the lobe outline is a near-circle about the rivet (35-37.5 px) that falls off only at its ends

piercing.tolerance: DESIGNED: free within +-25 % unless it breaks a MEASURED row
piercing.how: fan2's bare ribs carry openwork piercing between 0.13 and 0.37 L and fan1's carry small flower cut-outs; both are surface design for a later stage and are excluded here

length_L.how: tip flush with the leaf outer edge (+-0.01 L), plus the butt

width_profile_L.how: front guard: perpendicular profiles from the outer silhouette to the bright inner-edge highlight (fm_m12); fan1 is similar: 0.028 -> 0.038 -> 0.04-0.055

grip_section.value: no separate grip shape: the guard runs at about the same width down to the rivet; its outer edge flares ~0.006 L proud of the straight line below 0.45 L
grip_section.tolerance: qualitative: must read the same in a side-by-side render

tip.value: cut on the leaf arc, square to the axis, corners softened (fan1: rounded end)
tip.tolerance: qualitative: must read the same in a side-by-side render

edges.value: rounded / chamfered long edges: a continuous highlight runs along the inner edge
edges.tolerance: qualitative: must read the same in a side-by-side render

thickness_L.tolerance: DESIGNED: free within +-25 % unless it breaks a MEASURED row
thickness_L.how: about 2 x an inner rib; 1.9 mm at L = 190

rear_guard.value: identical to the front guard, mirrored; hidden behind the leaf in the leaf zone
rear_guard.tolerance: DESIGNED: free within +-25 % unless it breaks a MEASURED row

position.value: at the rib convergence; rivet image (398.2, 547.0)
position.how: rib boundary lines converge within 5 px of the ring centre (fan1 rms 0.97 px, fan2 3.6 px)

fan2_head_diameter_L.how: metal ring 12 px across with a dark 6 px (0.017 L) centre: a hollow, eyelet-style head

metal_colour.tolerance: qualitative: must read the same in a side-by-side render
metal_colour.how: neutral, faintly warm silver (nickel); polished metal

back_end.value: matching eyelet head on the back; each head proud of its guard by 0.006 L
back_end.tolerance: DESIGNED: free within +-25 % unless it breaks a MEASURED row

pleats.how: one pleat (a lit + an unlit face) per rib gap

alternation.value: rib folds = valleys seen from the front (sharp dark creases); mid-gap folds = mountains (soft rounded ridges)
alternation.tolerance: qualitative: must read the same in a side-by-side render
alternation.how: the ribs are invisible on the front of the leaf in both photos, so they lie behind it and every rib fold is a front valley; the sharp lit->unlit creases coincide with the edge notches within 0.5 deg; key light from the top (face contrast is lowest at phi 65-90)

face_tilt_beta_deg.how: lit/unlit face luminance ratio 3.5 (inner) .. 2.9 (outer), up to 3.8 by angle; Lambert with a key 45-60 deg off the fan normal gives beta 18-30; the edge-silhouette ripple gives 10-20

pleat_depth.value: mountain-to-valley depth d(rho) = 0.0572 rho tan(beta): 0.021 L at the outer edge, 0.009 L at the inner edge (flat wedge faces, depth proportional to radius)
pleat_depth.how: face contrast is nearly constant along the radius, so the faces are flat wedges

unfolded_leaf_angle_deg.how: 50 faces x atan(tan(3.264 deg) / cos(20 deg))

face_shape.value: faces read slightly convex (soft silk); creases sharp at the valleys, softer at the mountains
face_shape.tolerance: qualitative: must read the same in a side-by-side render

edge_scallop.how: sub-pixel outer radius, detrended (fm_m20); fan1 0.0074 L, sawtooth

inner_edge.value: clean circular arc about the pivot, not scalloped, no hem band
inner_edge.tolerance: qualitative: must read the same in a side-by-side render

material.value: single-layer silk-like fabric with a soft sheen, ribs glued behind
material.tolerance: qualitative: must read the same in a side-by-side render

attachment.value: the cord emerges from behind the lobe at its lower-left edge (0.110 L from the rivet, image direction 215 deg); threaded through the hollow rivet from behind
attachment.tolerance: qualitative: must read the same in a side-by-side render

how_it_hangs_in_photo.value: straight, lying out at image direction -159.7 deg (20 deg below horizontal, to the left): NOT hanging under gravity (flat-lay / posed product shot)

in_engine.value: hangs under gravity from the pivot; for the fan2 comparison render pose it along -160 deg
in_engine.tolerance: DESIGNED: free within +-25 % unless it breaks a MEASURED row

fullness.value: round bundle of fine threads, ~0.07 L thick at mid length (laid flat, width = diameter)
fullness.tolerance: DESIGNED: free within +-25 % unless it breaks a MEASURED row

colour_albedo.method: albedo = observed linear / (backdrop 0.922 lin x mean shading 0.8), as in the black-hat spec: absolute level +-35 %, chroma solid. Design and rib holes masked; tassel mask eroded 2 px.

leaf.how: observed lum 0.0176 (lit faces 0.0254, unlit 0.0101), hue 210 deg, sat 0.12: a cool blue-grey black

ribs.how: bare ribs, holes excluded, observed lum 0.0136, hue 200

guards.how: front guard face, observed lum 0.0144; the same material as the ribs within error, so ribs and guards are one part

tassel.how: interior, observed lum 0.0067, chroma [0.2402, 0.3057, 0.4541]: the most saturated (bluest) black; it sits at the pack's black floor (0.0097, #191919)

rivet.value: polished silver metal, near-neutral (hue ~37 deg, sat 0.035)
rivet.tolerance: qualitative: must read the same in a side-by-side render

fan1_cross_check.tolerance: qualitative: must read the same in a side-by-side render
fan1_cross_check.how: fan1 leaf is a navy black (sat 0.30); its ribs are a lighter grey-black (albedo ~0.056) with sheen

fan1_vs_fan2: opening: fan1 143 deg vs fan2 163 deg
leaf inner radius: fan1 0.462 L vs fan2 0.431 L
butt lobe: fan1 0.08-0.09 L vs fan2 0.106 L
rivet: fan1 solid silver dome 0.022 L vs fan2 eyelet ring 0.035 L
guard tip: fan1 rounded vs fan2 square-cut with softened corners
rib colour: fan1 lighter grey-black with sheen (~0.056) vs fan2 black (~0.018)
leaf hue: fan1 navy black (sat 0.30) vs fan2 blue-grey black (sat 0.12)
edge scallop: fan1 sawtooth 0.0074 L vs fan2 sinusoid 0.0066 L
camera: fan1 front-on vs fan2 tilted 11.5 deg top-away at ~3 L
tassel: fan1 none vs fan2 cord + knot + skirt
design (masked, not modelled): fan1 sakura/cats on 29 % of the leaf vs fan2 willow/swirls/seal on 12 %; both have pierced ribs

unseen_designed.back: the leaf back shows the 24 inner-rib slips glued along the valley folds up to 0.96 L; the rear guard lies over the leaf's back at the image-left end (mirror of the front); an eyelet rivet head on the back
unseen_designed.closed_state: all 26 sticks share one axis (for the rig: close symmetrically onto the fan bisector); the leaf folds into 50 stacked faces between the guards, its top edge flush with the guard tips; closed width = guard width (0.047 L at the tip); stack thickness 0.128 L at the pivot, ~0.10 L in the leaf zone
unseen_designed.thicknesses: inner rib 0.0045 L bare / 0.002 L in the leaf, guard 0.010 L, silk 0.0006 L
unseen_designed.tassel: hangs under gravity; cord through the hollow rivet; the knot as a round bead-like knot
